name: Engine R2: 2D stage on Three (textures, image, text, shape, group, opacity)
description: Builds the 2D MotionNodes on Three.js: image planes with textures, text drawn on a canvas into a CanvasTexture, shapes from ShapeGeometry with strokes, groups, opacity propagation through the tree, and the createNode dispatcher. Ends with a 2D smoke page. No Pixi.

readFirst: engine/docs/README.md (Pixi → Three table, decisions D10, D11)
engine/src/core/stage.ts, transform.ts, types.ts, visibility.ts, paths.ts and engine/src/schema/layers2d.ts (from M1 and R1)
engine/docs/port-map.md (rows for R2) and the library files they name in tmp/reacthub-pixitweenjs/src
extraGuardrails: Three.js only: no import of pixi.js, pixi-filters, @pixi/* or @react-three/* (lint enforces it).
jsdom has no 2D canvas context: text drawing is tested with an injected fake context and checked in the browser.

stories.title: loadImageTextures with an injectable loader and per-asset errors
stories.description: As a runtime author, I want every image asset loaded as a Three texture in parallel, with failures reported per asset, so that one broken image does not stop the doc.
steps: Read engine/docs/03-stage-2d.md section 'Textures' and tmp/reacthub-pixitweenjs/src/utils/loadSpriteTexture.ts.

Create engine/src/stage2d/textures.ts exporting loadImageTextures(doc, load?) (default: new THREE.TextureLoader().loadAsync(url) with colorSpace SRGBColorSpace) and disposeTextures(map); gltf and font assets are skipped.
Create engine/src/stage2d/textures.test.ts with a fake loader.
acceptance: With assets { a: image ok, b: image failing, c: gltf }, textures has only 'a', errors has one entry with assetId 'b', and the loader was called twice before either promise settled
Every returned texture has colorSpace SRGBColorSpace; disposeTextures calls dispose on each texture (spied)

stories.title: imageNode: a textured plane with sizing, anchor, tint and opacity
stories.description: As an author, I want image layers drawn as textured planes, sized by width or height with the aspect kept, so that plates and cut-outs drop in correctly.
steps: Read engine/docs/03-stage-2d.md 'Node types' (image row), 'Base transform', 'Opacity', and tmp/reacthub-pixitweenjs/src/components/PixiImageSprite/PixiImageSprite.tsx (sizing rules).

Create engine/src/stage2d/nodes/imageNode.ts exporting createImageNode: NodeFactory: createLayerObjects, a Mesh(PlaneGeometry(w, h)) at (w/2, -h/2) in content, MeshBasicMaterial({ map, color: tint }) through configure2DMaterial and blendingFor, applyBaseTransform; targets: base plus 'tint' (colour); applyOpacity sets material.opacity; ready resolves at once.
Missing texture: empty content, size 0x0, ready rejects with Error('motion: image asset <id> did not load'), creating it does not throw.
Create engine/src/stage2d/nodes/imageNode.test.ts with a THREE.Texture whose image is { width: 400, height: 200 }.
acceptance: For a 400x200 texture: layer width 200 gives a 200x100 plane, height 50 gives 100x50, neither gives 400x200 (checked via the geometry's bounding box)
The mesh's material has depthTest false, transparent true and toneMapped false; resolveTarget(undefined, 'tint') sets material.color to the written hex
applyOpacity(0.25) sets material.opacity to 0.25; a missing texture gives a rejecting ready whose message contains the asset id

stories.title: Text layout: lines, wrap, align, line height, letter spacing, padding (pure)
stories.description: As an engine developer, I want text layout as a pure function with an injected measure so that wrapping and alignment are unit-tested without a canvas.
steps: Read engine/docs/03-stage-2d.md section 'Text', engine/src/schema/layers2d.ts (text style) and tmp/reacthub-pixitweenjs/src/utils/textStyleV8.ts.

Create engine/src/stage2d/text/layout.ts exporting Measure, cssFont(style), textPadding(style) and layoutTextLines(text, style, measure) as specified (explicit \n, wrap on spaces at wordWrapWidth, long words on their own line, lineHeight default 1.2 x fontSize, x per align, y = baseline per line, total width and height).
Create engine/src/stage2d/text/layout.test.ts with a fake measure where every character is 10 px wide (plus letterSpacing per character).
acceptance: cssFont({ fontWeight: '700', fontSize: 96, fontStyle: 'normal', fontFamily: 'Inter, sans-serif' }) returns '700 96px Inter, sans-serif' (italic adds 'italic ' first)
'aaa bbb ccc' with wordWrapWidth 75 gives 2 lines ('aaa bbb', 'ccc'); with no wordWrapWidth it gives 1 line of width 110
With align 'center' and lines of widths 70 and 30, the second line's x is 20; with 'right' it is 40
textPadding with stroke width 4 and dropShadow blur 6 distance 5 returns 11; layout of identical input gives deep-equal output

stories.title: textNode: draw on a canvas into a CanvasTexture, fonts, fill redraws
stories.description: As an author, I want text layers with stroke, shadow, wrap and alignment rendered sharply on the Three stage so that titles look designed.
steps: Read engine/docs/03-stage-2d.md 'Text' (padding, drawing order, fonts, redraw rule) and tmp/reacthub-pixitweenjs/src/utils/fonts/fontLoader.ts.
Create engine/src/stage2d/text/draw.ts exporting drawText(ctx, layout, style, pixelRatio, padding): shadow, then stroke (lineJoin round), then fill, at 2x pixel ratio.

Create engine/src/stage2d/nodes/textNode.ts exporting createTextNode: NodeFactory with an injectable canvas factory (for tests): ready waits for document.fonts.load(cssFont(style)) when available, measures with the canvas context, lays out, draws, wraps the canvas in a CanvasTexture (SRGBColorSpace) on a plane of (width + 2 padding) x (height + 2 padding) offset by -padding; size() excludes padding; 'fill' colour target redraws the canvas and sets texture.needsUpdate; applyOpacity sets the plane material opacity.
Create engine/src/stage2d/nodes/textNode.test.ts with a fake canvas whose 2D context records calls and measures 10 px per character.
acceptance: For text 'Hi' at fontSize 50 with the fake context, size() is { width: 20, height: 60 } and fillText was called once with 'Hi'
With a stroke of width 4, strokeText is called before fillText and the plane is 8 px wider than size().width
Writing '#ff0000' through resolveTarget(undefined, 'fill') calls fillText again with fillStyle '#ff0000' and sets texture.needsUpdate (version increments)
When document.fonts is missing, ready still resolves and the text is drawn with the fallback

stories.title: shapeNode: rounded rect and ellipse from ShapeGeometry, stroke ring, fill
stories.description: As an author, I want rectangles and ellipses with optional rounded corners and strokes so that I can build cards, bars and badges.
steps: Read engine/docs/03-stage-2d.md 'Node types' (shape row) and tmp/reacthub-pixitweenjs/src/components/PixiShapeLayer/drawShape.ts.

Create engine/src/stage2d/nodes/shapeNode.ts exporting createShapeNode: NodeFactory: build a THREE.Shape for a rect (quadratic corners when radius > 0, radius clamped to half the shorter side) or an ellipse in content space ((0,0) to (w,-h)); fill mesh from ShapeGeometry (curveSegments 32); stroke mesh from a ring shape (outer shape with the inset shape as a hole) when stroke is set; materials through configure2DMaterial and blendingFor; targets base plus 'fill' (colour); applyOpacity on both materials.
Create engine/src/stage2d/nodes/shapeNode.test.ts.
acceptance: A rect 200x100 has a fill geometry whose bounding box spans x 0..200 and y -100..0; with radius 80 the radius is clamped to 50
An ellipse 200x100 has a bounding box 200 by 100 and its geometry's centre is at (100, -50)
With stroke { color: '#000000', width: 4 } there are two meshes and the stroke geometry's bounding box equals the fill's
Writing '#00ff00' through resolveTarget(undefined, 'fill') sets the fill material colour; applyOpacity(0.5) sets both materials' opacity to 0.5

stories.title: groupNode, createNode dispatcher and opacity propagation
stories.description: As a runtime author, I want one createNode call for any layer, nested groups with offset times, and opacity that multiplies down the tree, so that groups fade their children like the library's containers did.
steps: Read engine/docs/03-stage-2d.md 'Node types' (group row), 'Opacity' and 'createNode'.

Create engine/src/stage2d/nodes/groupNode.ts (children built through a passed create function with the group's absolute start, their displays added to content in order, size from the union of the children's local bounding boxes in pixels, ready = all children, destroy destroys children) and engine/src/stage2d/createNode.ts (dispatch on type; three from factories.three; missing factory throws naming the type).
Create engine/src/stage2d/opacity.ts exporting applyOpacityTree(nodes, parentOpacity = 1).
Create engine/src/stage2d/index.ts re-exporting the public API, and tests createNode.test.ts and opacity.test.ts.
acceptance: A group starting at 2 with a child starting at 1 gives the child start 3; a grandchild in a nested group starting at 0.5 gets start 3.5
createNode on a three layer without factories.three throws an error naming 'three'; with a fake factory it returns that node
applyOpacityTree with group alpha 0.5 and child alpha 0.5 calls the child's applyOpacity with 0.25
Destroying a group calls destroy on every child node (spied)

stories.title: 2D smoke page: basic-2d on the Three stage
stories.description: As a project owner, I want to see images, text, shapes and groups drawn by Three before the runtime exists so that look and colour problems show up now.
steps: Read engine/lab/three-smoke.tsx (from R1: renderer settings, stage, hash) and engine/fixtures/basic-2d.json.

Create engine/lab/stage-smoke.tsx: WebGLRenderer with the runtime settings, stage Scene with the doc background and createStageCamera, loadImageTextures, createNode for every layer (factories.three from createThreeNode), renderOrder by depth-first index, a seek slider that sets visibility with isVisible, calls applyOpacityTree and renders; show the hash and the RGBA of a clicked canvas pixel.
Create the stubs web/motion-stage-smoke.html and web/src/dev/motion-stage-smoke.tsx (one line importing ../../../engine/lab/stage-smoke) following the existing stub pattern.
Open http://localhost:5173/motion-stage-smoke.html, check text sharpness, anchors, the group and the #ff0000 shape colour; save screenshots to debug/engine/.
acceptance: Every layer of basic-2d is visible at a time when it is on, in the right place, with crisp text (screenshot saved, described in notes)
Clicking the #ff0000 shape reads back (255, 0, 0) within 1 per channel
No console errors, and engine/lab/stage-smoke.tsx imports nothing from pixi
